summary: Complete brief: format, genre, style, audience, traits and evaluation requirements supplied. Hard constraints must be separated from defaults; no provider architecture invented.
prompt: Derive the production profile for a pack with this brief — format: 60–90 s short; genre: gothic fantasy; style: puppet stop-motion with visible armature seams accepted; audience: adult; must: practical-light look, stepped 12 fps motion cadence, no dialogue; defaults: 16:9, muted palette; evaluation: accept stepped motion, reject interpolation smoothing, reject material drift.
